sourcePurpose: Generated raster house artwork; transparent masters and alpha-preserving downscales.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent raster house sprite for the top-down 2D transport-building game Transport.
Primary request: a convincing small workers' cottage, 1930s European railway town architecture, designed to be legible after reduction to 32 pixels. Single modest one-storey buff plaster cottage with warm weathered terracotta gable roof, dark blue-green front window pair, wooden front door, brick chimney, very small entry path and two low shrubs.
Camera: elevated orthographic view looking down about 50 degrees, FRONT of house faces straight towards bottom of image, almost no horizontal camera rotation. Roof ridge horizontal. Show roof surface and front wall, a narrow right wall allowed. No diamond/isometric plinth.
Style: richly crafted realistic miniature game asset, hand-painted raster with crisp silhouette, believable roof tiles, masonry, wooden trim, deep eave shadows, subtle wear. Broad readable shapes and strong light/dark grouping, no cartoon thick outline, not vector clip art, not voxel, not flat front elevation.
Composition: ONE house only, centered square image, complete silhouette with generous clean transparent padding on every side. Occupies about80% of the frame width, ground contact near85%height. Tiny garden/path details only, no large terrain rectangle, no road, no landscape, no people, no lettering.
Lighting: consistent soft sunlight from upper left, short soft contact shadow extending bottom right. Muted warm earth palette compatible with sage-green terrain.
Output: genuinely transparent alpha background, not a painted checkerboard or white field. Intended working asset256×256 (generate at supported size; will be precisely reduced to256 and game-size sprites).

Edit the reference house into a NEW architecture variant for the same game asset set. Use case: precise-object-edit. Change the architecture to: a small rustic timber cabin: weathered honey-brown horizontal wooden siding, steep charcoal slate gable roof, modest covered front porch with two wooden posts, one small dark teal window beside the offset wooden door, sturdy stone footings, a little stacked firewood. It is an affordable one-storey cabin, distinctly different from the plaster cottage.
Keep the reference's richly textured realistic hand-painted miniature rendering, elevated orthographic camera looking down about50degrees, front facade toward bottom, nearly horizontal roof ridge, muted natural materials, upper-left daylight, crisp silhouette and deep eave shadows. One complete building only, same square composition, transparent alpha background, short subtle contact shadow. Tiny foundation/garden details only. No solid rectangular terrain base, no diamond plinth, no people, no text, no watermark. Retain generous transparent margins and ground contact near85%height. Strong simple value groups so this reads well downscaled to32pixel game sprites. The result should be a beautiful plausible little building, never a flat vector icon.
